summary: Implemented the window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and extends the ControlCode union with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True when the control is buffered and False when not a terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Per instructions, tests and Black were not run; formatting was checked by hand against 88 columns. Nothing was committed. One note: when the console is a dumb terminal, control() skips the write, so set_window_title can return True without any bytes being written.
